agent_review_comments_deleted_check.name: agent_review_comments_deleted_check
agent_review_comments_deleted_check.value: ("agent_review_comments"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("agent_review_comments"."body") > 0) or ("agent_review_comments"."deleted_at" is not null and "agent_review_comments"."body" = '')

agent_review_threads_anchor_check.name: agent_review_threads_anchor_check
agent_review_threads_anchor_check.value:
("agent_review_threads"."anchor_kind" = 'review' and "agent_review_threads"."revision_id" is null and "agent_review_threads"."side" is null and "agent_review_threads"."line" is null and "agent_review_threads"."line_hash" is null)
        or ("agent_review_threads"."anchor_kind" = 'line' and "agent_review_threads"."side" is not null and "agent_review_threads"."side" in ('base','head') and "agent_review_threads"."line" is not null and "agent_review_threads"."line" between 1 and 100000 and "agent_review_threads"."line_hash" is not null and "agent_review_threads"."line_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

model_reservations_nonneg.name: model_reservations_nonneg
model_reservations_nonneg.value: "model_reservations"."reserved_micros" >= 0 and "model_reservations"."reserved_input_tokens" >= 0 and "model_reservations"."reserved_output_tokens" >= 0 and ("model_reservations"."actual_micros" is null or "model_reservations"."actual_micros" >= 0)

run_node_sessions_otel_session_shape.name: run_node_sessions_otel_session_shape
run_node_sessions_otel_session_shape.value: "run_node_sessions"."otel_session" is null or coalesce(jsonb_typeof("run_node_sessions"."otel_session") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("run_node_sessions"."otel_session"->'events') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(case when jsonb_typeof("run_node_sessions"."otel_session"->'events') = 'array' then "run_node_sessions"."otel_session"->'events' else '[]'::jsonb end) <= 1000 and jsonb_typeof("run_node_sessions"."otel_session"->'dropped') = 'number', false)

runs_trace_ids_shape.name: runs_trace_ids_shape
runs_trace_ids_shape.value: ("runs"."trace_id" is null) = ("runs"."trace_root_span_id" is null) and ("runs"."trace_id" is null or ("runs"."trace_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' and "runs"."trace_id" <> repeat('0', 32) and "runs"."trace_root_span_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' and "runs"."trace_root_span_id" <> repeat('0', 16)))

tenants_use_case_check.name: tenants_use_case_check
tenants_use_case_check.value: "tenants"."use_case" is null or ("tenants"."parent_id" is not null and char_length("tenants"."use_case") between 1 and 200 and "tenants"."use_case" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*(/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*$')

tenants_tree_check.name: tenants_tree_check
tenants_tree_check.value:
"tenants"."depth" >= 0 AND "tenants"."depth" <= 32
	AND ("tenants"."parent_id" IS NULL) = ("tenants"."depth" = 0)
	AND ("tenants"."parent_id" IS NULL) = ("tenants"."root_id" = "tenants"."id")
	AND "tenants"."parent_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "tenants"."id"
	AND "tenants"."path" ~ '^(/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})+/$'
	AND char_length("tenants"."path") = 37 * ("tenants"."depth" + 1) + 1
	AND "tenants"."path" LIKE '%/' || "tenants"."id"::text || '/'
	AND "tenants"."path" LIKE '/' || "tenants"."root_id"::text || '/%'
